[[:File:Battledepths map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name=Battledepths | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=625 }} The Battledepths is the only normal explorable area in the Depths of Tyria. The main chamber is empty until completing all parts of [[Northern Allies]], after which [[King Jalis Ironhammer|Jalis Ironhammer]] and his servants appear in the northwestern corner of the map, near the exit to [[Varajar Fells]]. ==Getting there== Head southwest from [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]], or head southeast from [[Olafstead]]. This area cannot be entered until every [[character]] in the [[party]] has watched [[the First Vision]] cinematic. ==Quests available== *[[King Jalis Ironhammer]] **[[Heart of the Shiverpeaks (quest)|Heart of the Shiverpeaks]] {{Quest icon|Primary}} *[[Orozar Highstone]] **[[Attack on Jalis's Camp]] **[[In the Service of Revenge]] *[[High Priest Alkar]] **[[Destructive Research]] **[[The Destroyer Challenge]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 1 [[Beacon of Droknar]] ([[Dwarven Raider]]) [[Dwarves]] (Only after Jalis arrives) *{{w}} 24 [[Dwarven Soldier]] *{{w}} 24 [[King Jalis Ironhammer|Jalis Ironhammer]] (mission starter) *{{w}} 20 [[Orozar Highstone]] *{{w}} 24 [[Telzar Ironjaw]] *{{r}} 24 [[Dwarven Scout]] *{{mo}} 24 [[Dwarven Mender]] *{{mo}} 20 [[High Priest Alkar]] *{{n}} 24 [[Dwarven Necromancer]] *{{me}} 24 [[Dwarven Sage]] *{{x}} 24 [[Rothgar]] ([[merchant]]) ===Foes=== [[Dragon]]s *{{e}} 20 (26) [[Chromatic Drake]] [[Elemental]]s *{{r}} 20 (26) [[Icy Stalagmite]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Frozen Elemental]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Shattered Elemental]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Avalanche]] *{{d}} 20 (26) [[Whirling Wisp]] *{{d}} 24 (26) [[Chilling Wisp]] ==Notes== * In the small corridor leading to the room in southwest, the party can be caught in [[Avalanche (effect)|avalanche]]. * The portal to the [[Central Transfer Chamber]] is closed before completing [[Destruction's Depths]]. * Like most non-Nightfall underground explorable areas, this area cannot be vanquished. {{Explorable areas in the Depths of Tyria}} [[de:Schlachttiefen]]
